scope.independence: Author implementation and verification only; no independent review claim for this owned source. New tests use real SQLite metadata and transactions, not actual CPU worker execution.

contract.v1: Original exact 17-field schema-1 record, generic phase acceptance, all digests and bounds remain unchanged. Existing generic future_controller_adapter control and same-table v1 action-phase control stay valid; no new training-only constraint is imposed.
contract.v2: Exact integer schema=2 and exact adapter='native_cpu_action'; original fields minus source_file_sha256/execution_identity plus adapter/action_sha256/domain_run_sha256/observation_records_sha256. Full source_ref must use phase='action'. No other legacy or extra fields accepted.
contract.digest_meaning: action_sha256 is action_fingerprint(action); domain_run_sha256 is digest({'domain_run': metadata_or_None}); artifact/observation record digests use digest({'records': records}). This store validates exact lowercase SHA-256 syntax and sealed record digest, not the underlying executable, domain metadata, artifact, observation, scientific correctness or adapter closure.
contract.immutable_table: Same exact three-column replication_requests table; original DDL, read queries, schema validation and all public signatures unchanged.
contract.insertion: Caller-owned write transaction, exact current TERMINAL full source Ref and row/terminal digests checked before and after insertion. Plain INSERT only: duplicate request/task identity raises SQLite IntegrityError and never overwrites. Coordinator lookup/replay, not an upsert, supplies idempotent workflow behavior.
contract.reads: Detached, bounded historical reads convey no current execution permission; source becoming stale does not delete a mapping but prevents a fresh insertion using that source.
contract.bounds: Existing 16,384-byte full canonical record cap, 4096-byte absolute canonical scope/database strings, 1024-byte reason, 128-byte creation text, strict token/full Ref/generation and lowercase 64-hex digests retained.
